name: Kuruki-chan the Cat
storyline:
Once upon a time, in Biscuit Town—a wonderful place filled with all kinds of sweets and treats—the Catizens lived together in peace and harmony.
But one day, a witch cat appeared and stole everyone's sweets, leaving the town completely empty-handed...
But worry not! Because our hero, the "Brave Cat" Kuruki-chan, has volunteered to set out on a journey to defeat the witch cat and bring all the treats back to everyone!
summary: Kuruki-chan is a cute, bright, and heartwarming RPG adventure game that will surely heal your soul.
